Title II, ACC-HHS-CDC-TOTAL -- printed as 'Total, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention' 7,992,946 [FY 2025 Estimate], PDF p.342 (printed p.338). Source: H.Rept. 119-271's 'FY 2025 Estimate' column, which the report defines (pp.319-320) as 'FY 2025 Operating Plans and other available information'; FY2025 was a full-year continuing resolution (P.L. 119-4, Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025, division A). Equals the P.L. 119-4 level: continued at the FY2024 level by P.L. 119-4 sec. 1101(a)(8) (division D of P.L. 118-47); no exception names it.
